title: The profiled Gaussian energy cannot recenter the unrestricted bottom to bounded error

bounded_recentering.gaussian_bottom: Let lambda_N^prof be K1572's exact finite-cutoff stationary diagonal Gaussian minimum and E_N the unrestricted translation-invariant bottom.
bounded_recentering.diverging_gap: K1587 supplies an admissible translation-invariant Ritz vector with energy lambda_N^prof-Theta_g(N^(5/2)); therefore lambda_N^prof-E_N>=c_g N^(5/2) eventually.
bounded_recentering.recentering_exclusion: For every a_N=lambda_N^prof+o(N^(5/2)), and in particular a_N=lambda_N^prof+O(1), inf spec(H_N-a_N)->-infinity. The profiled Gaussian energy is not a bounded-error recentering of the unrestricted theory.
bounded_recentering.class_compatibility: K1577 remains exact on T_N^+: the Ritz vector necessarily exits the nonnegative integrated Wick-defect class opened by K1582. The new result separates exact class coefficient from unrestricted subleading behavior without contradicting class rigidity.
bounded_recentering.leading_limit_open: Because N^(5/2)=o(N^4), the descent is compatible both with E_N/N^4->h_g^prof and with a strictly smaller unrestricted coefficient. The true-ground shift E_N+O(1), its compactness and Mosco liminf/recovery remain open.
bounded_recentering.scope_guard: This excludes bounded-error recentering by the profiled Gaussian value, not bounded-error recentering by the unknown true E_N. It is not a spectrum, resolvent or continuum interacting-operator theorem.
